title: ttl-batch-sizing-policy
description: Declarative form of the TTL batch-sizing policy. Mirrors the prose rule in viv-orchestration-rules so consumers (hooks, orchestrator scripts) can read ceiling/margin/cap as data from one declarative source. See viv-orchestration-rules ADR-005 for the prose policy.

id.description: Stable identifier referenced by other rules via dispatch_constraints.max_batch_size_ref.

version.description: Semver of this policy. Increment on calibration changes.

ttl_seconds.description: Host runtime's per-dispatch TTL in seconds.

ttl_renewable.description: Whether the TTL can be extended in-dispatch. Always false in this network (preserves isolation guarantee).

empirical_value.description: Maximum items per dispatch above which truncation probability becomes unacceptable. CALIBRATED empirically, not estimated.

calibration_basis.description: How the ceiling was derived. Free-form; references to telemetry runs welcome.
examples: Empirical ~15-18 items at TTL 600s for codegen workloads; see orchestrator telemetry logs.

workload_type.description: Workload category this ceiling applies to. Different workloads may have different ceilings.

last_calibrated.description: ISO date of the last calibration update.

safety_margin.description: Multiplier applied to ceiling to derive the operational cap. Default 0.8 per ADR-005.

cap_formula.description: How cap is computed from ceiling and margin. Single allowed value to prevent ad-hoc formula drift; if a different formula is needed, propose via ADR.

failure_policies.description: Per-agent-category default failure policies for the per-item atomicity contract. Per viv-typed-agents ADR-RD-013.

per_category_recommendation.description: Recommended policy per agent category. Authors override at agent-definition time with justification.

evidence_requirements.description: Extended evidence fields the orchestrator audits when dispatching with N > 1. Pairs with the standard evidence-schema rule.

telemetry.description: Hints for the orchestrator about what telemetry to emit so calibration of `ceiling` can evolve empirically.

truncation_observed.description: Emit a flag on abrupt termination.
